body:
#1866 (BUG-1173) RequestChanges ADDRESSED — pushed 9d04372ae to bug-1173-work, ready for your re-review + merge (it's my code, so the merge gate is yours, not mine).

Fix exactly as you specified: set_pr_number now stamps ONLY the local .aida/merge-holds/PR-N marker at PR-detection (the race-block), and the aida:merge-hold LABEL is deferred to record_merge_supervision_hold (post-CI) — which already did write_hold + sync_label. So merge-hold-gate stays green during phase-2 CI-watch → no drive self-shelve, while the concurrent-merger race stays closed by the local marker. sync_label now appears in exactly 2 prod sites (wave-leg 47704 + record_merge_supervision_hold), zero at detection.

Regression test: added a source-assertion test (bug_1173_detection_hold_tests::set_pr_number_stamps_marker_but_not_label) — this repo's idiom per check-removed-flags.sh — that fails if merge_hold::sync_label is ever re-added to the set_pr_number body. Passes; fmt clean; cargo check green. I went source-assertion rather than a driver-loop mock because there's no RealPhaseDriver test scaffolding and the label side-effect is a gh subprocess (unobservable without a seam) — if you'd rather I refactor set_pr_number to inject the label-applier for a true behavioral test, say so and I'll do it. Otherwise this guards the exact regression.

Operator was present + directed the fix ("fix what you can"), so this was supervised, not an unattended patch. Rebasing #1746 next.
